name: chart-line-03
title: chart-line-03
description: Choose a reporting window. Switch between the full half-year and the latest quarter.

meta.prompt:
Create a responsive analytics card titled “Explore subscriber growth” with the muted eyebrow “Choose a reporting window”. Fill available width up to 576px. Use a theme-aware card surface, rounded border, an 18px title, a prominent 30px semibold metric with tabular numerals, and a separated muted footer.

Plot subscriber values 186, 225, 208, 284, 312, 368 from Jan–Jun with a monotone 3px line and 4px dots. Above the plot, provide small 6 months and 3 months buttons in a Reporting window group. Start with six months selected; switching to three months shows Apr–Jun. Indicate selection through filled versus outlined styling and accessible pressed states. Show 368 subscribers and a footer explaining the window switch.

Keep the plot 260px tall and responsive to the card width. Provide accessible chart navigation and value tooltips. Use month labels, a numeric vertical axis, dashed horizontal grid lines, and clean axes without tick marks or axis lines.
